info.title: Agentic Runtime Agent API
info.description: Call a published agent with an agent API key. Create a conversation, send a message, stream the reply, attach a file, and read that run's trace. The same key authenticates the MCP server and A2A tasks. Send Idempotency-Key on a message so a retry returns the original run.
